selection_rationale: The dataset reports sensitivity over ten control depths, the target frequency, the pulse family, coherence parameters, uncertainty bars, and a high-depth decline. A single best-sensitivity value would not have been sufficient.
independence_statement: Pham et al. (2012) was not directly cited as a source for the explicit values in the existing Table 1 scenario files and no parameter is adjusted to its measured optimum. The project's review references may discuss this experiment, so this is described as a holdout trend validation rather than a claim of complete bibliographic independence.

source.citation: L. M. Pham et al., Enhanced solid-state multi-spin metrology using dynamical decoupling, Physical Review B 86, 045214 (2012).

reported_parameters.sample_description: approximately 10^3 aligned sensing NV centres in a 30 cubic micrometre volume at room temperature
reported_parameters.parameter_note: These are the experimental parameters stated in the Figure 3 caption for the paper's Eq. 2 curve. The text also reports approximately 300 microseconds for Sample C; the caption-specific 250 microseconds is used here.

pulse_timing_convention.scope_note: The holdout uses an n-pulse XY sequence rather than complete XY8 blocks. The scalar model is therefore compared at equal total pulse count and resonant timing; this test does not validate XY8-specific phase cycling.

predeclared_baseline_assumptions.overhead_source: sum of existing nominal scenario t_init, t_read, and t_dead
predeclared_baseline_assumptions.photon_rate_treatment: not reported; omitted because each curve is normalized to its own minimum and a depth-independent rate cancels
predeclared_baseline_assumptions.contrast_treatment: reported C=0.1 is retained in the score but cancels after within-curve normalization
predeclared_baseline_assumptions.no_fit_statement: Neither pulse fidelity, overhead, coherence parameters, nor horizontal position is fitted to the digitized optimum.

missing_parameter_uncertainty.range_source: predeclared envelope spanning the project's conservative-to-optimistic scenario fidelities and zero-to-conservative total overhead

digitization.source_asset: author-supplied fig3.eps from the arXiv source archive
digitization.pulse_counts: rounded to the nearest even pulse after axis calibration; the first two values agree with n=28 and n=54 identified in the paper
digitization.reported_error: vertical error-bar half width digitized from the plotted bars
digitization.normalization: experimental and predicted curves are each divided by their own minimum; no shape parameter is fitted
